description: EduRolia is an admissions CRM for private schools, publicly funded schools, and education groups. Connect your account to review the admissions pipeline, identify families that need follow-up, and search authorized students, families, and contacts. Each user can access only the schools allowed by their EduRolia account. The current version is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete CRM records.

defaultPrompt: Resume el pipeline actual de admisiones de mi centro.
Dime qué admisiones necesitan seguimiento y cuáles son más urgentes.
Busca una familia, alumno o contacto por nombre en mis admisiones.
